headline: Password manager mSecure warns users to reset credentials after cyberattack
summary: mSeven Software, maker of the mSecure password manager, is telling current and former customers to change their passwords and reset two-factor authentication and passkeys after a cyberattack. BleepingComputer reports the attack reportedly exposed an encrypted customer database, while the Register says the company has not explained what was compromised.

claims.statement: mSecure's maker, mSeven Software, is warning customers to reset passwords, 2FA, and passkeys after a cyberattack.

sources.quote: mSeven Software is warning current and former mSecure password manager customers to change passwords, reset two-factor authentication, and remove passkeys following a cyberattack that reportedly exposed an encrypted customer database. [...]
